title: Doge's website is just a great ads x
text:
In a Press Conference at the Oval Office This week, Elon Musk promised that the actions of his so -called government efficiency department (Doge) would be “to the maximum transparent”, thanks to the information published on their website.
At the time of your comment, the Doge’s website was empty . However, when the site finally entered online on Thursday morning, it turned out to be little more than a glorified diet of publications of the official Doge account on Musk’s own X platform, asking new questions about Musk’s about Musk’s Conflicts of interest in Doge’s career .
Doge.gov claims to be an “official website of the United States government”, but instead of giving detailed savings and cost efficiencies, it states that Musk states that his project is doing, the home page Replicate Publications of the Doge account in x.
A source code cable review shows that the promotion of Musk’s own platform was deeper than replicating the publications on the home page. The source code shows that the site Canonic labels Direct search engines to x.com instead of dege.gov.
A canonical label is a code fragment that tells search engines what is the authorized version of a website. In general, it is used by sites with multiple pages as an optimization tactic of search engines, to prevent its search classification from being diluted.
However, in the case of Dege, the Code informs search engines that when people are looking for content found in Dege.gov, they should not show those pages in search results, but must show publications in X.
“It is promoting the X account as the main source, with the secondary website,” Declan Chidlow, A web developer Wired says. “Thus it is not usually how things are handled, and indicates that the X account is having priority over the real website.”
All other US government websites. In addition, by sharing the Doge website on mobile devices, the source code creates a link to the DEGE X account instead of the website itself.
“It seems that Doge’s website is secondary, and are pushing people in the address of the X account worldwide,” adds Chidlow.
Together with the feeding of the X posts home page, a Doge.gov section labeled as “savings” appears. Until now, the page is empty, except by a single line that says: “The receipts that will arrive soon, no later than Valentine’s Day”, followed by a heart emoji.
A section entitled “Labor Force” presents some bar graphics that show how many people work in each government agency, with information from data collected by the Personnel Management Office in March 2024.
A discharge of responsibility in the lower part of the page says: “This is Doge’s effort to create an integral organization of organization of the entire government. This is a huge effort, and there is likely some mistakes or omissions. We will continue to fight for maximum precision over time. ”
Another section, entitled “Regulations”, presents what Doge calls the “unconstitutionality index”, which describes as “the number of rules of the agency created by bureaucrats not chosen for each law approved by Congress in 2024”.
